    Product Details
    Pampers Active Baby Size 4+ Pack 62 disposable nappies are designed to offer superior comfort and protection for your baby. They contain lotion with Aloe Vera to help prevent skin rash by keeping the baby's skin dry. The nappies feature three absorbing layers that absorb wetness quickly and lock it away, along with absorbing channels that distribute wetness evenly to prevent sagging. For a secure and comfortable fit, they include soft stretchy sides with re-adjustable tapes and double leg elastics to prevent leaks around the thigh area. The pack also includes big 5 animal characters for fun during nappy changes.
